thread:
nightly-eval-bot: ALERT: nightly eval run failed 3 suites (severity: medium). Suites: finance-cohort, longcontext-rerank, instr-qa. Link: https://internal.redwood/evals/1749998888 · Summary: surge in blank/irrelevant generations for int4 variant.

maria: saw the alert, starting first-pass. pulling the eval diffs now.

sam: thanks. any idea if this aligns with the int4 rollout yesterday?

maria: preliminary: yep looks correlated. failing rate up ~12% vs baseline on finance-cohort. longcontext got truncation/empty outputs. instr-qa shows wrong instruction following in several few-shot prompts.

keisha: i rolled the int4 candidate to staging at ~1749950000 (PR #1748). no other infra changes. pinging logs. :eyes: 

vinod: on it, checking agent logs and p99 latencies. KV cache misses look normal. no obvious IO spikes.

maria: quick reproducer command if you want to run locally:
```
./scripts/run_eval.sh --suite finance-cohort --model rdx-2.1-int4 --seed 42 --log-level debug
```

maria: sample failing generation from finance-cohort: "" (empty). several prompts return "<no-output>" token.

keisha: odd — that empty token pattern is something we've seen when quantization kernel falls back and returns empty string on edge prompt lengths. i will diff kernel selection logs.

eva: can we confirm it's not dataset corruption? maybe seed shuffle changed. i can re-run the suite against the canonical dataset S3 URI.

vinod: grep of recent eval logs: `grep -n "<no-output>" /var/logs/eval/1749998888/*.log | wc -l` -> 124 hits across finance-cohort and longcontext. instr-qa has 37 hits.

sam: proposed immediate triage steps: 1) roll eval on float16 / non-quant to confirm it's quant-only. 2) re-run int4 with `--disable-kernel-fallback` to capture stack traces. 3) assign owners and ETA for first-findings.

maria: assigning: finance-cohort -> @maria, longcontext-rerank -> @keisha, instr-qa -> @vinod. i'll start float16 repro for finance now. ETA 30m.

keisha: i'll pull kernel selection logs and diff the qkernel config between last-good and current int4 build. ETA 45m.

vinod: i'll re-run instr-qa with seed sweep (42, 7, 99) and stash logs to /tmp/eval-triage/1749998888. will also enable `--trace-kv`. ETA 20m.

eva: i'll re-run against canonical dataset to rule out data drift. ETA 25m.

maria: quick note: if float16 passes, we likely narrow to quant-specific decoding path. if float16 fails too, escalate to runtime infra.

sam: marking severity escalated to medium-high until we confirm repro. please add all outputs to the ticket: https://internal.redwood/tickets/ENG-ML-1934 and tag me.

keisha: found PR #1748 change: qkernel flag `allow_empty_generation=true` was added for perf fallback. undoing to test might fix. running small sample.

maria: float16 run passed initial smoke for finance (0/200 empties). int4 still 18/200 empties.

keisha: reverting `allow_empty_generation` locally -> small sample now shows 0 empties. pushing a debug patch to staging (no rollout).

vinod: instr-qa seed sweep shows variability but empties persist only on int4. stack traces show fallback branch in qkernel called for specific attention length.

maria: good find. next steps: keisha, leave patch in staging and run full nightly suites against it. vinod + eva cross-validate. i'll prepare a short postmortem draft if rollback needed.

sam: thanks team. update ticket with results and tag infra if patch doesn't hold. i'll standby for rollback decision. :thumbsup:
